title: If...
description: 6 source pictures with individually matched captions. 根据教材照片恢复逐图正文。
answer_note: Lesson picture captions are transcribed from the textbook photograph. Listening practice answers are supplementary. Independent Practice and Grammar answer provenance is recorded in their exercise groups.

lesson.text: If you break this window, you'll have to pay for it!
lesson.translation: 如果你打破这扇窗户，就得赔偿！

lesson.text: If you don't hurry, we'll miss the train.
lesson.translation: 如果你不快点，我们就赶不上火车了。

lesson.text: If he falls, he'll hurt himself.
lesson.translation: 如果他摔下来，会受伤的。

lesson.text: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the seaside.
lesson.translation: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去海边。

lesson.text: If you feel better, you can get up.
lesson.translation: 如果你感觉好些，就可以起床了。

lesson.text: If he sells that car, he can buy a new one.
lesson.translation: 如果他卖掉那辆车，就能买一辆新的。

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。
lesson.context: Supplementary practice based on the photographed captions. 依据照片正文补充的练习。

questions.prompt: Picture 1: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If you break this window, you'll have to pay for it!

questions.prompt: Picture 2: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If you don't hurry, we'll miss the train.

questions.prompt: Picture 3: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If he falls, he'll hurt himself.

questions.prompt: Picture 4: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go to the seaside.

questions.prompt: Picture 5: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If you feel better, you can get up.

questions.prompt: Picture 6: Say the sentence(s).
questions.answer: If he sells that car, he can buy a new one.

lesson.title: Written A: Answer the questions (about Lesson 137)
lesson.instruction: Read the dialogue in Lesson 137 again. Then answer these questions. 重读第 137 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.translation: 重读第 137 课的对话，然后回答以下问题。
lesson.context: 4 comprehension questions about the Lesson 137 dialogue (Brian and Julie).

questions.prompt: What has Brian nearly finished?
questions.answer: He has nearly finished the football pools.

questions.prompt: What will Brian do if he wins a lot of money?
questions.answer: If he wins a lot of money, he'll buy Julie a mink coat.

questions.prompt: What does Julie want to do?
questions.answer: She wants to see the world.

questions.prompt: What will they do if they spend all the money?
questions.answer: If they spend all the money, they'll try and win the football pools again.

lesson.title: Written B: Write sentences like the example
lesson.instruction: Write sentences like the example. 按照例句写句子。
lesson.context: 5 'if' sentence items; item 1 (If it rains tomorrow, she'll stay (or she may stay) at home.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, she'll stay (or she may stay) at home.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, she'll stay at home.

questions.prompt: If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go to the seaside.
questions.answer: If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go to the seaside.

questions.prompt: If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor.
questions.answer: If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor.

questions.prompt: If you can't make up your mind, she'll ask a friend.
questions.answer: If you can't make up your mind, she'll ask a friend.

questions.prompt: If you don't get the job, he'll retire.
questions.answer: If you don't get the job, he'll retire.

lesson.title: Written C: Answer the questions
lesson.instruction: Answer the questions. 回答以下问题。

questions.prompt: What will you do if it rains tomorrow?
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay at home.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you are ill next week?
questions.answer: If I am ill next week, I'll see a doctor.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you can't make up your mind?
questions.answer: If I can't make up my mind, I'll ask a friend.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you don't get the job?
questions.answer: If I don't get the job, I'll retire.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you win a lot of money?
questions.answer: If I win a lot of money, I'll travel to England.

practice.title: Practice A: Complete the sentences with 'if'
practice.instruction: Look at this. 请看下表。Then write sentences like the example. 按照例句写句子。
practice.translation: 请看下表。然后按照例句写句子。
practice.context: 6 'if' sentence items; item 1 (If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go / he may go to the seaside.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go / he may go to the seaside.
questions.answer: If it's nice at the weekend, he'll go to the seaside.

questions.prompt: If he can't make up his mind, he'll ask a friend.
questions.answer: If he can't make up his mind, he'll ask a friend.

questions.prompt: If he doesn't get the job, he'll retire.
questions.answer: If he doesn't get the job, he'll retire.

questions.prompt: If I win a lot of money, I'll travel to England.
questions.answer: If I win a lot of money, I'll travel to England.

questions.prompt: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay at home.
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I'll stay at home.

questions.prompt: If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor.
questions.answer: If you are ill next week, you'll see a doctor.

practice.title: Practice B: About you
practice.instruction: What will you do if you win a lot of money? Write down three or four things. 如果你赢得一大笔钱后准备做的三四件事。
practice.translation: 如果你赢得一大笔钱后准备做的三四件事。
practice.context: 4 open-ended personal writing items; the workbook answer key gives only possible sample answers.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you win a lot of money? (thing 1)
questions.answer: I'll travel around the world.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you win a lot of money? (thing 2)
questions.answer: I'll buy a new computer for myself and one each for my brothers and sisters.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you win a lot of money? (thing 3)
questions.answer: I'll go to England and then to the U.S.A.

questions.prompt: What will you do if you win a lot of money? (thing 4)
questions.answer: I'll buy a big house in the country.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Combine each pair of sentences, using “if”
grammar.instruction: Combine each pair of sentences, using “if” according to the example. 仿照例句用 if 合并下列句子。
grammar.translation: Combine each pair of sentences, using “if” according to the example.
grammar.key_source: pdf p.573 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 8 sentence-pair items combined with “if” following the printed example; item 1 is a printed example (shown, not editable); items 2-8 are editable; answers from the answer key.

questions.prompt: You’re six years old. /You can go to school.
questions.answer: If you’re six years old, you can go to school.

questions.prompt: You have enough money. /You can buy that bike.
questions.answer: If you have enough money, you can buy that bike.

questions.prompt: You speak German well. /You can work in Germany.
questions.answer: If you speak German well, you can work in Germany.

questions.prompt: You have a good voice. /You can be a singer.
questions.answer: If you have a good voice, you can be a singer.

questions.prompt: You win the prize. /You will get ten thousand yuan.
questions.answer: If you win the prize, you will get ten thousand yuan.

questions.prompt: You finish your homework. /You can go out to play.
questions.answer: If you finish your homework, you can go out to play.

questions.prompt: You are not feeling well. /You can have a rest.
questions.answer: If you are not feeling well, you can have a rest.

questions.prompt: You get good marks in the exams. /You can go to a good university.
questions.answer: If you get good marks in the exams, you can go to a good university.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Make sentences according to the example
grammar.instruction: Make sentences according to the example. 仿照例句造句。
grammar.translation: Make sentences according to the example.
grammar.key_source: pdf p.573 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 cue items turned into first-conditional sentences following the printed example; item 1 is a printed example (shown, not editable); items 2-10 are editable; answers from the answer key.

questions.prompt: she/eat too many bananas/she/feel sick
questions.answer: If she eats too many bananas, she will feel sick.

questions.prompt: she/not sweep the floor/her mother/be angry
questions.answer: If she doesn’t sweep the floor, her mother will be angry.

questions.prompt: you/come back late/you/must tell me
questions.answer: If you come back late, you must tell me.

questions.prompt: you/listen to me carefully/you/understand
questions.answer: If you listen to me carefully, you will understand.

questions.prompt: I/have time/I/learn another language
questions.answer: If I have time, I will learn another language.

questions.prompt: you/speak English every day/you/speak English better
questions.answer: If you speak English every day, you will speak English better.

questions.prompt: you/drive too fast/a policeman/stop you
questions.answer: If you drive too fast, a policeman will stop you.

questions.prompt: you/are more careful/you/make fewer mistakes
questions.answer: If you are more careful, you will make fewer mistakes.

questions.prompt: he/finish his homework early/he/watch television
questions.answer: If he finishes his homework early, he will watch television.

questions.prompt: you/pay for these books/I/have them
questions.answer: If you pay for these books, I will have them.
